description: Reads the experiments in ~/.suunto-mcp/experiments.json: status (upcoming, running, finished, stopped), metric, dates, TODAY's assignment (arm intervention | control | washout | none, instruction, followed), progress and adherence. With `id`, `selected` is the whole experiment (hypothesis, analysis plan, seed, schedule, day log). Local file only: no Suunto call, writes nothing. A damaged or other-version file is an error naming it.

id.description: Experiment id, e.g. 'e1', for the full schedule and log.

name: get_experiment
title: Get experiments: today's assignment, progress, adherence
